repairs.title: Regional junior results appear under the wrong ball-level rating
repairs.scope: Named competition and B-division ball-level fallback classification; boys and girls.
repairs.symptoms: Overberg or West Coast Trials U10 B, or Ceres U9 B, is classified as Green/Yellow despite the confirmed Orange playing format.
repairs.cause: Without explicit ball metadata or a recognised label, the default classification is standard. The existing Wilson U9 B fallback does not cover these competitions.
repairs.fix: Apply the shared named-event and exact-division Orange fallback in BallRatingModel and BallRatingContext. Preserve explicit court/ball labels and unrelated event/division classifications. Increment the classification version to invalidate old saved calculations. See docs/performance/ball-level-classification.md.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-03 the focused model and isolated SQLite pipeline checks passed 9 tests/175 assertions; independent model and catalogue checks passed 11 tests/237 assertions before the final ambiguity guard, which was independently reviewed afterward. Coverage includes both genders, event isolation, explicit metadata precedence, ambiguous combined fields, finishing fields and canonical matches. A broader 22-test run had three unresolved monthly/pathway/private-import failures; baseline attribution was not verified.
repairs.limits: Classification does not manufacture results or change publication, identity or confidence gates. Saved ratings and history require the canonical refresh workflow; this guide does not execute a refresh, mutate production or authorize deployment.

repairs.title: Legacy home event feed throws a missing controller method exception
repairs.scope: GET /events/ajax/home compatibility endpoint for the public home event feed.
repairs.symptoms: The legacy event feed raises BadMethodCallException during controller dispatch.
repairs.cause: The events.ajax.home route referenced HomeController::homeEvents, which does not exist.
repairs.fix: Point the legacy route to HomeController::get_events, also used by home.events.get. Retain the route name and URL and share the canonical visibility, search, period and pagination logic instead of duplicating it.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-03 the local MySQL legacy-route regression passed 1 test with 10 assertions, covering guest response parity, search, second-page pagination, exact totals and draft exclusion. Route registration, PHP lint and Blade compilation passed. No production or browser verification is claimed.
repairs.limits: This guide executes no repair or deployment. Confirm current route registration and rerun the focused regression; local route changes do not establish production behavior.

repairs.title: Round-robin groups finish one at a time instead of rotating
repairs.scope: Individual round-robin schedule planning; not team ties or a repair of played schedules.
repairs.symptoms: One group completes its programme before another starts, despite a request to rotate group rounds.
repairs.cause: A planner that orders fixtures by group alone omits the dependencies between group turns. Check current code and saved assignments before diagnosing an existing event.
repairs.fix: Use EventVenueScheduleService planning with configureRoundRobinGroupRotation: visit each group's round before the next round, larger full groups first and equal sizes by name. Preserve fixed and played assignments, rest, court availability and playoff feeders. Review the proposed schedule through the existing scheduling workflow before saving; publication is separate.
repairs.verification: Reviewed current owning source and regression definitions on 2026-11-02. The referenced regression covers unequal groups, partial selections, day batches and spare courts. Source review is not a claim of fresh event, browser, deployment or live verification.
repairs.limits: This guide performs no replanning, database repair or publication. Confirm event authorization and current state. If current code already follows this rule, investigate constraints rather than removing them or resetting matches.

repairs.title: Director net payment leaves clothing deductions unreconciled
repairs.scope: Recording an already-paid full director settlement; registration funds and explicitly linked regional clothing only.
repairs.symptoms: The registration-only amount differs from the projected net payout because a linked clothing deficit must be withheld, or clothing payable must be included.
repairs.cause: A registration-only director payment does not create the corresponding clothing settlement evidence. Recording only the cash amount leaves a residual registration balance and the clothing deficit unchanged.
repairs.fix: Use the full outstanding balance option in Record payment to director. Review the server-derived registration balance, each linked clothing adjustment and actual net cash paid. Supply actual payment time and reference and confirm the already-paid amount. EventDirectorNetSettlementService atomically records the registration settlement and canonical linked clothing legs. A linked recovery is withholding, not a second cash receipt. Reject stale previews, ambiguous recipients, insufficient registration funds for deductions, and unsupported chronology; do not invent cross-region offsets.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 the focused net-settlement, reimbursement and payout-projection suite passed 24 tests with 230 assertions. DeploymentConfigTest passed 41 tests with 189 assertions. Checks are local; this record does not claim deployment or live verification.
repairs.limits: Clothing recording remains super-user only. Pending refunds remain reserved and may leave a clothing ledger balance even when currently payable amounts are zero. Requires the reviewed director settlement link migration. This guide executes no transfer, refund, publication or deployment and grants no new assistant action.

repairs.title: Category-copy request fails on natural wording and spoken leg numbers
repairs.scope: The event assistant's reviewed category-copy capability and background improvement notes; no live event mutation from this guide.
repairs.symptoms: The assistant asks for a special command format when a user says copy the source event categories to the destination, uses spoken leg numbers, or joins sponsor names with and.
repairs.cause: The earlier parser required categories from SOURCE to DESTINATION and split destination names at every and, including sponsor names.
repairs.fix: Support both explicit word orders, normalize spoken leg numbers and sponsor punctuation/order, and resolve the whole destination before splitting a real destination list. Keep bounded unique accessible matches and source year/place for inferred shorthand; show candidate names/IDs when ambiguous rather than guessing. Continue through the existing category preview and confirmed apply services. For a genuinely unsupported or unresolved instruction, use the actor-opted-in improvement handoff to save a deduplicated note for background review; a note does not execute the task or train a model.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 the independently run isolated assistant suite passed 128 tests and 986 assertions, including natural wording, ambiguity/year boundaries, preview/confirmation safety, automatic-note isolation and existing assistant flows. This is local test evidence, not live activation evidence.
repairs.limits: Exact event IDs/full names remain available. Typos are not silently guessed. Copying categories still needs the reviewed confirmation and preserves fee, authorization, stale-state and duplicate checks. Automatic forwarding is off by default and requires a separate exact actor allowlist; credential detection is heuristic and earlier conversation/draft fields are excluded. Background changes require tests and reviewed deployment before the live application learns the capability.

repairs.title: Upcoming team fixtures retain old roster names or playing order
repairs.scope: Source-aware team fixtures; authorised roster maintenance during open registration, without rewriting played history.
repairs.symptoms: A corrected roster name remains stale in fixtures, or generated matches unnecessarily force an order-confirmation step during open registration.
repairs.cause: Upcoming fixture snapshots retained their creation names, and roster-order confirmation did not distinguish an open registration period from a closed event.
repairs.fix: Use canonical roster claim, imported-name correction, profile update and playing-order workflows. TeamParticipantHistoryService refreshes verified upcoming snapshot display names under the event lock while preserving source identity and link attestations. Open non-Trials team events save playing order through RosterOrderProtectionService without an extra confirmation; the same rollback checks still protect bookings, publication, results, started matches and unrelated teams. See DK-26 for boundaries.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 the isolated automatic-update and draw-adaptation suites passed 28 tests with 155 assertions. Coverage includes post-draw registration eligibility/claim, name corrections, order saves, stale revisions/order, idempotency, player conflicts, event isolation and started/result protection. No live event was changed.
repairs.limits: Locked, placement-draft and source-less legacy fixtures require organiser review. Structural additions still need scheduling and publication. Closed registration retains order confirmation. This guide grants no production or publication authority and executes no repair.

repairs.title: Past-event history refresh returns Too Many Requests after ordinary rating-page visits
repairs.scope: Authenticated player past-event rating-history refresh requests; no rating calculation or evidence-policy changes.
repairs.symptoms: The update-history form opens a bare 429 page even when the player history has not recently been refreshed.
repairs.cause: Unnamed numeric route throttles share the authenticated actor signature. Ordinary rating-page requests can consume the two-per-minute refresh allowance before the refresh controller runs.
repairs.fix: Authorize player-rating access first, then apply a dedicated actor-wide history-refresh limiter in PlayerEventRatingHistoryController. Keep two requests per minute across all players for that actor. Browser saturation redirects to the authorized history page with a retry message; JSON receives 429 with retry_after. Both include Retry-After and private no-store headers. Preserve the worker's per-player cooldown, request coalescing, lease and global builder lock.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 the focused isolated MySQL regression run passed 5 tests with 55 assertions, including unrelated-throttle isolation, retry expiry, actor-wide cross-player budgets, independent actors, denied-target precedence, existing entitlement checks and worker coalescing. This is local evidence only.
repairs.limits: This guide does not run a reconstruction, change saved ratings, remove rate limits, grant rating access, or authorize deployment. Private evidence and existing access gates remain unchanged.

repairs.title: Player Plus discovery needs an age-group Top 10 and individual rating lookup
repairs.scope: Ordinary Player Plus discovery for an authorised linked player; administrative full-list browsing remains separate.
repairs.symptoms: Plus members have no age-group Top 10, while a broad name search reveals several ratings together.
repairs.cause: The member discovery projection withheld ranking lists entirely and returned scores in every matching search suggestion.
repairs.fix: Derive the member's Overall CTR Top 10 from the selected authorised player's calendar-year age group and gender. Junior groups include younger players; missing birth dates do not produce a broad list. Ignore submitted age, gender, level, page and page-size list overrides for members. Return at most ten alphabetically matched public names without scores, then reveal one selected eligible candidate's Overall CTR. Keep selected identity bound to the current search candidates and preserve publication, convergence, comparability and entitlement checks.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 PlayerRatingTopTenTest passed locally with 17 tests and 304 assertions using isolated SQLite. Coverage includes member filter tampering, ten-player bounds, one-player search selection, publication revocation, disconnected estimates, missing birth dates and administrative browsing. This is local evidence only.
repairs.limits: Search reveals only the selected comparable public rating, not private history or evidence. This does not grant player ownership, alter ratings, enable opponent badges, or authorize deployment.

repairs.title: Super Admin workspace save feedback and toggle overlap
repairs.scope: Legacy Super Admin workspace browser handlers; no settings, ledger or production repair action.
repairs.symptoms: Conduct or terms save buttons remain disabled, dismissed feedback stops appearing, or Save All overwrites an autosaving checkbox.
repairs.cause: Content callbacks referenced a notifier outside its lexical scope; Bootstrap dismissal removed its reusable node; disabled in-flight checkbox controls were omitted from form serialization and missing booleans were saved as false.
repairs.fix: Keep content callbacks and notifier in the same ready closure, hide rather than remove reusable feedback, block full-form save while toggle, annual-price, template or content requests are pending, serialize before disabling the form, and restore only previously enabled controls in completion callbacks. Main destinations now use server-selected GET pages; initialize only present, visible local tables and editors. Preserve dedicated settings endpoints and server authorization.
repairs.verification: Nine executable JavaScript handler/navigation regressions passed locally on 2026-11-02. Authenticated presentation/access checks also passed within the 130-test isolated MySQL dashboard suite. These checks do not establish live settings behavior.
repairs.limits: No automatic settings mutation or production action. Monthly-only fields remain independent of the full-form payload. Preserve user-owned worktree changes and verify current owning handlers before applying the procedure.

repairs.title: Player Plus requires repeated checkout clicks and manual navigation after verified payment
repairs.scope: Player Plus consent-to-PayFast handoff and payer-only return navigation; no provider payment execution from this guide.
repairs.symptoms: A payer confirms purchase, then repeats Pay and Continue to PayFast; returning after payment requires navigating through membership details to ratings.
repairs.cause: Purchase creation, canonical handoff and signed form submission were separate screens, and the provider returned to the billing receipt.
repairs.fix: Use the direct consent workflow: canonical start, accurate immutable-price and plan comparison, current matching terms audit, then canonical handoff under the same transaction. Render the signed POST bridge with one automatic submission and a visible manual fallback. Reused mismatched or already handed-off attempts stay on their saved order review without repricing, repeat handoff or false new acceptance. The dedicated read-only provider return checks completed verified paid flags, an active purchased term, absence of reconciliation, real player linkage and entitlement before opening My Tennis's rating tab. Pending returns use bounded read-only status checks with request timeouts; sponsors and closed or review cases retain their receipt.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-02 all six scoped Player Plus feature classes passed against guarded local MySQL ct_testing: 77 tests, 743 assertions. Six JavaScript tests passed for one-shot fake-form submission, manual fallback, bounded polling, timeout recovery and safe destination handling. No provider or live payment was initiated.
repairs.limits: Both explicit purchase and recurring consents, exact saved amounts, payer ownership, idempotency, five-minute expiry, signature and COMPLETE verification remain mandatory. Provider return query parameters never activate membership. Normal order receipts and renewal management remain accessible. This guide authorizes no production action, payment or deployment.

repairs.title: Registration payout retries or corrections distort director balances
repairs.scope: Super Admin evidence recording for already-paid registration payouts, signed accounting corrections and event director reconciliation.
repairs.symptoms: Repeated payout submission creates duplicates, deletion removes original evidence, or a recorded recipient payment is still offered through director settlement.
repairs.cause: Legacy recording lacked payload-bound idempotency and immutable correction links; director projections included only dedicated director or expense purposes.
repairs.fix: Use FinancialLedgerService and EventPayoutRecordingService. Lock the event, validate exact cents and event-bound recipient, bind a UUID retry to actor/event/payload, and require canonical audit evidence in the same transaction. Correct only an incorrect eligible record through a confirmed reasoned opposite entry; retain both originals and corrections immutable. Include signed generic and legacy payments consistently in director general/full-net projections. Unidentified, unmatched, orphaned, conflicting or ambiguous recipient allocations block affected settlement; never match names.
repairs.verification: The local isolated MySQL dashboard run passed 130 tests and 1088 assertions on 2026-11-02, including 17 payout integrity regressions, both wallet entry points and existing director/ledger suites. The correction migration passed a MySQL down/up round trip; DeploymentConfigTest passed 42 tests and 190 assertions.
repairs.limits: Requires database/migrations/2026_11_02_220000_add_event_payout_corrections.php. Recording or correcting evidence transfers no money and is not a bank refund. Linked director/clothing settlements require their own reconciliation. No production execution or automatic assistant action is authorized.

repairs.title: Settings saves need atomic audit evidence without raw content leakage
repairs.scope: Six Super Admin settings endpoint families; operational flags, fees, offers, templates and legal content.
repairs.symptoms: Bulk save can partially persist, generic logs omit coherent operation context, or raw template/legal/contact input appears in request audit history.
repairs.cause: Independent model saves invalidate cache before commit and generic request/model audit paths can duplicate raw submitted values.
repairs.fix: Collect and validate changes first. Use SettingsMutationService to enforce actor/key/group authority, lock existing database snapshots in key order, persist and require non-null canonical settings.updated evidence in one transaction. Retain scalar operational old/new values and use hashes/lengths for content/contact/logo values. Scope attempted and completed SettingsController request audit to submitted field names. Invalidate changed cache keys after commit; preserve the normal cached getter and unrelated model auditing.
repairs.verification: Nine settings mutation regressions passed within the 130-test local isolated MySQL dashboard run on 2026-11-02. Coverage includes all six route gates, exact old/new evidence, integrity hashes, no-op retries, audit failure rollback, commit-timed cache invalidation, privacy across request/business logs and unchanged existing checkout prices.
repairs.limits: This guide changes no live settings and restores no old policy automatically. Existing generic settings auditing was not absent; the repair adds coherent sanitized transaction-bound evidence. Do not globally disable model or request auditing.

repairs.title: Hidden dashboard tabs load expensive data or capped previews imply full totals
repairs.scope: Super Admin server-selected workspaces and their read-only financial/operational datasets.
repairs.symptoms: Opening Settings computes event ledgers or mail reports, queues stop at arbitrary caps, or financial totals change with the visible event page.
repairs.cause: One consolidated controller materialized every tab and client-only pagination hid incomplete server collections.
repairs.fix: Allowlist the selected workspace and use GET navigation. Load cheap shell aggregates separately; query and render only the selected detail panel. Pair conditional markup with guarded plugin resources and visible-table initialization. Server-paginate queues with stable order and retained tab/search/subtab context, and calculate true totals independently. Stream all selected-year events through the canonical ledger in bounded chunks while retaining only the displayed summary rows; never sum a single page as the year total.
repairs.verification: Eight workspace loading/pagination regressions and authenticated presentation/access checks passed within the local isolated MySQL dashboard suite on 2026-11-02. Nine executable JavaScript regressions cover save coordination, GET navigation and local subtab/audit initialization. No production timing benchmark is claimed.
repairs.limits: Read pagination does not authorize financial mutations, publication or broader access. Keep all Settings subpanes in their selected page's form to preserve bulk-save semantics. Independent refund model paginators must retain their companion page context.

repairs.title: Saved pathway badge has no highlighted competition while an update is pending
repairs.scope: Player Plus personal pathway snapshot; saved comparable standard-ball rating positioning only.
repairs.symptoms: A saved numeric badge is visible but none of Wilson B, Wilson A or TSA is highlighted when progression is not assessed.
repairs.cause: The visual current position used suggestedCompetition, which correctly becomes unavailable when the freshness assessment is pending.
repairs.fix: Use PlayerPathwayService currentCompetition to position the latest saved comparable nonlocal standard-ball score against configured cutoffs. Render the current card with aria-current and latest saved badge wording. Keep suggestedCompetition, assessed and readiness subject to freshness. Retain matching player, publication validation, entitlement and comparability gates. Use the shared loading modal on pathway navigation with timeout and pageshow cleanup.
repairs.verification: On 2026-11-03 local focused PHP checks passed 34 tests and 500 assertions; independent frontend checks passed seven tests. Coverage includes stale saved positioning, exactly one highlighted card, cutoff boundaries, invalid scores, local estimates, player mismatch and revoked evidence. Synthetic browser checks passed loading success/failure and navigation at 390/1440 pixels. No production verification.
repairs.limits: Saved position is not a fresh progression recommendation or event eligibility. No rating recalculation, publication, ownership change or production action is authorized by this guide.
